questions.question: Kis word mein letter 'l' silent hai?
questions.explanation: 'walk' ko 'wawk' bola jaata hai, yahan l silent hai (jaise talk, calm mein). lamp, hold aur film mein l clearly bola jaata hai.

questions.question: 'Light the lamp before it gets dark.' Is sentence mein 'light' kaunsa part of speech hai?
questions.explanation: Yahan 'light' ek command/action hai (lamp ko jalao), isliye yeh **verb** hai. 'The light is on' mein yeh noun hota aur 'a light bag' mein adjective.

questions.question: 'Farmers sell fresh produce at the market.' Is sentence mein 'produce' ka stress kahan hai?
options: PROduce: 1st syllable, kyunki yahan yeh noun hai
proDUCE: 2nd syllable, kyunki yahan yeh noun hai
proDUCE: 2nd syllable, kyunki yahan yeh verb hai
questions.explanation: Yahan 'produce' ka matlab hai fruits/vegetables, yaani yeh noun hai. Aise noun/verb pairs mein noun ka stress 1st syllable par hota hai (PROduce) aur verb ka 2nd par (proDUCE).

questions.question: Kis sentence mein 'fast' ek **adverb** ki tarah use hua hai?
options: He kept a fast during the festival.
questions.explanation: 'moved fast' mein 'fast' verb 'moved' ko describe karta hai (kaise moved?), isliye adverb hai. Option A mein noun hai, B mein adjective (runner ko describe karta hai), aur D mein verb.

questions.question: Kis sentence mein tense ki galti hai?
options: We were watching TV when the lights went out.
He usually takes the bus to work.
I have finished the report yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'yesterday' jaisa finished past time present perfect ('have finished') ke saath nahi aata; sahi hai 'I finished the report yesterday'. Baaki teeno sentences sahi hain.

questions.question: Sentence ke kis part mein error hai? 'Yesterday, / she buys / a new phone / from the market.'
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' past time batata hai, isliye verb simple past mein hona chahiye: 'she bought'. Simple present 'buys' yahan galat hai.

questions.question: Kis word mein bolte waqt exactly **teen** syllables hain (spelling nahi, pronunciation dekho)?
questions.explanation: de-ci-ded: 'd' ke baad -ed ek extra syllable 'id' banata hai, isliye 3 syllables. Wednesday 'WENZ-day' (2), strengths (1) aur cupboard 'CUB-erd' (2) hain; spelling dekh kar zyada ginna common galti hai.

questions.question: Kis sentence mein capital letters wala stress **sahi** hai?
options: We need a perMIT to enter the area.
The teacher will not PERmit phones in class.
Sales showed a steady INcrease this year.
Please don't OBject to the plan.
questions.explanation: 'a steady increase' mein increase noun hai, toh stress 1st syllable par: INcrease. Noun 'permit' PERmit hota hai, verb 'permit' perMIT, aur verb 'object' obJECT; options A, B aur D mein yeh ulta hai.

questions.question: log₁₀ 4 + log₁₀ 25 ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: log a + log b = log(ab), toh log₁₀ (4 × 25) = log₁₀ 100 = 2. log₁₀ 29 tab aata jab galti se log a + log b = log(a + b) maan lete; 100 to log ka argument hai, value nahi.

questions.question: Line 3x − 2y + 8 = 0 ka slope aur y-intercept kya hai?
questions.explanation: y ke liye solve karo: 2y = 3x + 8, yaani y = (3/2)x + 4. Toh slope 3/2 aur y-intercept 4. Sign ki galti ya y ke coefficient se divide na karna baaki options deta hai.

questions.question: f(x) = 2x + 3 aur g(x) = x² − 1 hai. (f ∘ g)(2) kya hai?
questions.explanation: (f ∘ g)(2) = f(g(2)). g(2) = 4 − 1 = 3, phir f(3) = 2·3 + 3 = 9. 48 = g(f(2)) hai (order ulta), aur 21 = f(2)·g(2) hai, jo composition nahi hai.

questions.question: f(x) = (2x + 7)/3 hai. f⁻¹(x) kya hoga?
questions.explanation: y = (2x + 7)/3 likho aur x ke liye solve karo: 3y = 2x + 7, toh x = (3y − 7)/2. Isliye f⁻¹(x) = (3x − 7)/2. Check: f(f⁻¹(x)) = (3x − 7 + 7)/3 = x. 3/(2x + 7) reciprocal hai, inverse nahi.

questions.question: x² − 8x + k = 0 ke roots real aur distinct (alag-alag) hon, iske liye k ki condition kya hai?
questions.explanation: Real aur distinct roots ke liye discriminant > 0: 64 − 4k > 0, yaani k < 16. k = 16 par roots equal hote hain, isliye k ≤ 16 galat hai; k > 16 par roots real hi nahi hote.

questions.question: θ = 5π/6 radians ho toh sin θ ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: 5π/6 radians = (5/6) × 180° = 150°. sin 150° = sin(180° − 30°) = sin 30° = 1/2, aur second quadrant mein sin positive hota hai. √3/2 sin 60° (ya sin 120°) hai.

questions.question: Agar α aur β equation 3x² − 5x + 1 = 0 ke roots hain, toh α² + β² kya hai?
questions.explanation: α + β = 5/3 aur αβ = 1/3. α² + β² = (α + β)² − 2αβ = 25/9 − 6/9 = 19/9. 25/9 sirf (α + β)² hai, 22/9 tab aata jab 2αβ ki jagah sirf αβ ghataate, aur 31/9 tab jab 2αβ jod dete.

questions.question: Point (1, 3) se guzarne wali aur line 3x − 4y + 7 = 0 ke **perpendicular** line ka equation kya hai?
questions.explanation: Di gayi line ka slope 3/4 hai, toh perpendicular slope −4/3. y − 3 = (−4/3)(x − 1) se 3y − 9 = −4x + 4, yaani 4x + 3y − 13 = 0. Option A parallel line hai, B ka slope +4/3 hai, aur C point (1, 3) se nahi guzarti.

questions.question: 4 Ω aur 8 Ω ke resistors **series** mein ek 12 V battery se jude hain. Circuit mein current kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Series mein R = 4 + 8 = 12 Ω, toh I = V/R = 12/12 = 1 A. 3 A aur 1.5 A sirf ek resistor lene se aate hain; 4.5 A parallel combination (8/3 Ω) maan lene se.

questions.question: Ek digital thermometer mein temperature sensor, ek microcontroller (jo reading ko °C mein badalta hai) aur ek LCD display hai. Block diagram mein LCD display kis block mein aayega?
questions.explanation: LCD result ko user tak pahunchata hai, isliye yeh output block hai. Temperature sensor input hai aur microcontroller processing karta hai.

questions.question: 10 Ω aur 15 Ω parallel mein hain; yeh combination 6 Ω ke saath series mein hai. Ab yeh poora network ek 12 Ω resistor ke saath parallel mein laga hai. Equivalent resistance kya hai?
questions.explanation: 10 ∥ 15 = (10 × 15)/(10 + 15) = 6 Ω; phir 6 + 6 = 12 Ω; aakhir mein 12 ∥ 12 = 6 Ω. 43 Ω sab ko series maanne se aata hai, 12 Ω aakhri parallel step bhoolne se, aur 2.4 Ω sab ko parallel maanne se.

questions.question: 10 A ka current ek node par 2 Ω aur 3 Ω ke do parallel resistors mein bant jaata hai. 2 Ω resistor mein kitna current jaayega?
questions.explanation: Current division: I₂Ω = 10 × 3/(2 + 3) = 6 A. Kam resistance wali branch mein zyada current jaata hai. 4 A formula mein resistances ulta lagane se aata hai (wo 3 Ω ka current hai).

questions.question: Ek node par 4 A aur 2.5 A ke currents andar aate hain, aur 1.5 A ek branch se bahar jaata hai. Chauthi branch ke current I ka magnitude aur direction kya hai?
questions.explanation: KCL: andar aane wala total = bahar jaane wala total. 4 + 2.5 = 1.5 + I, toh I = 5 A, aur yeh node se bahar jaata hai. 8 A sab currents ko jodne se aata hai, jo KCL ke against hai.

questions.question: Ek 2 kW geyser roz 45 minute chalta hai. 30 din mein bijli ka bill kitna hoga agar rate ₹8 per kWh hai?
questions.explanation: Energy = 2 kW × (45/60) h × 30 = 45 kWh. Cost = 45 × 8 = ₹360. ₹21,600 minutes ko hours mein convert na karne se aata hai, ₹480 roz 1 hour maanne se, aur 45 to energy (kWh) hai, cost nahi.

questions.question: Ek single loop mein 20 V battery, R₁ = 2 Ω, R₂ = 3 Ω aur ek unknown resistor R series mein hain. R₂ ke across voltage 6 V hai. R ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Loop current I = 6/3 = 2 A. KVL: 20 = 2·2 + 6 + V_R, toh V_R = 10 V aur R = 10/2 = 5 Ω. 10 Ω poore loop ka total resistance (20/2) hai, sirf R nahi.

questions.question: 4 Ω aur 12 Ω parallel mein hain, aur yeh combination 3 Ω ke saath series mein ek 24 V source se juda hai. 12 Ω resistor mein kitni power dissipate hoti hai?
questions.explanation: 4 ∥ 12 = 3 Ω, total = 6 Ω, I = 24/6 = 4 A. Parallel part ke across V = 4 × 3 = 12 V, toh P = V²/R = 144/12 = 12 W. 36 W 4 Ω ki power hai, 96 W total power hai, aur 48 W poore 24 V ko 12 Ω par maanne se aata hai.

questions.question: Is C code ka output kya hoga?
questions.code:
int a = 29, b = 6;
printf("%d %d", a / b, a % b);
questions.explanation: Dono `int` hain, isliye `a / b` integer division hai: 29/6 = 4 (decimal part kat jaata hai). `a % b` remainder deta hai: 29 − 24 = 5. Output: 4 5.

questions.question: Is code ka output kya hoga?
questions.explanation: `%.2f` decimal ke baad sirf 2 digits print karta hai (rounding ke saath), isliye 3.14. Sirf `%f` hota toh default 6 digits aate (3.141590), aur `%.3f` se 3.142.

questions.question: Is code ka output kya hoga?
questions.explanation: `x / y` mein dono `int` hain, toh pehle integer division hota hai (3) aur phir 3.0 store hota hai. `(float)x / y` mein cast pehle hota hai, isliye float division: 3.5. Output: 3.0 3.5.

questions.question: Is statement ke baad `v` ki value kya hogi?
questions.explanation: `*`, `/`, `%` ki precedence `+`, `-` se zyada hai, aur same level par left-to-right chalte hain. 3*4 = 12; 8/2 = 4, phir 4%3 = 1; 2 + 12 − 1 = 13. Sab kuch left-to-right karne se 0 aata hai.

questions.question: Is code ka output kya hoga?
questions.explanation: Pehli chain mein `t > 30` true hai, toh "Hot " print hota hai aur `else if` skip ho jaata hai. Doosra `if` ek alag statement hai, isliye woh bhi check hota hai: 35 > 25 true, toh "Sunny". Output: Hot Sunny.

questions.question: Is code ka output kya hoga?
questions.explanation: i ki values: 2, 6, 10, 14 (agla 18 > 14, loop rukta hai). s = 2 + 6 + 10 + 14 = 32. 18 tab aata jab 14 ko chhod dete (condition `<=` hai, `<` nahi), 30 tab jab 2 ko bhool jaate, aur 104 = 2 se 14 tak ka poora sum.

questions.question: Is code ka output kya hoga?
questions.explanation: `a--` purani value compare karta hai, phir a ghatata hai. 5 > 2: a = 4, b = 4; 4 > 2: a = 3, b = 7; 3 > 2: a = 2, b = 9; 2 > 2 false, par decrement phir bhi hota hai, toh a = 1. Output: 1 9.

questions.question: ASCII maan lo ('A' = 65). Is code ka output kya hoga?
questions.explanation: `n / 2` integer division hai = 3, phir 3 + 2.5 = 5.5, jo `%.2f` se 5.50 print hota hai. `n % 4` = 3. `'A' + 2` = 67, aur `%c` use character ki tarah print karta hai: C. Output: 3 5.50 C.
